_note: report-state's checked-in routing corpus — the test of record. Positives are real requests for a STATE-OF / SITUATION snapshot: a comprehensive, honest current-state of an entire system / portfolio / domain — full inventory, a health-signal matrix, trend trajectory, a gap map, where things stand right now. Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from the three near-synonymous report-* siblings — a bounded project's PROGRESS / STATUS over a period (what moved) is report-progress; a CIA-style intel BRIEF for rapid knowledge transfer is report-brief; a formal STRATEGY brief with glossary + recommendations is report-strategic — plus resume-author. The hard boundary is report-progress: state = a whole system's comprehensive condition (what exists / where we stand); progress = a bounded body of work's movement this period (what's done / blocked / next). Each negative belongs to a NAMED sibling. routing-eval is lexical-overlap only; 'health'/'RAG'/'status' overlap with report-progress is a proxy limit, not a defect.
